title: Elections 2026
text:
NC House District Results
This map colors each district by the party of its leading candidate. Candidate votes are summed across precincts; in a race with only one listed candidate, that candidate is shown. District boundaries are from the 2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line state legislative district files.
